title: Compiling Multi-Threshold Operators for Quantized Non-Monotonic and Fine-Granular Activations in Custom-Tailored DNN Accelerators
abstract: arXiv:2610.21825v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aggressive quantization of neural networks can expose activation functions as bottlenecks for efficient hardware acceleration. Implementing quantized activations as multi-threshold operations has been shown to be a promising optimization, allowing for efficient hardware implementation of few-bit activations. However, current implementations are limited to monotonically increasing functions, quantization schemes with one-dimensional (per-channel) granularity and a small set of predefined activation-quantizer combinations. We formalize the multi-threshold representation to extend it to non-monotonic functions and fine-granular parameters, i.e., multi-dimensional thresholds. For automated conversion of quantized function compositions into threshold representation, we propose a systematic approach via algebraic rules integrated into the ONNX-based compiler infrastructure. translated_title: 为定制DNN加速器编译多阈值算子以支持量化的非单调与细粒度激活函数
translated_abstract: 对神经网络进行激进量化后，激活函数可能成为高效硬件加速的瓶颈。将量化激活函数实现为多阈值操作已被证明是一种有前景的优化方法，能够实现少比特激活函数的高效硬件实现。然而，当前的实现仅限于单调递增函数、具有一维（逐通道）粒度的量化方案以及少量预定义的激活-量化器组合。我们对多阈值表示进行了形式化，将其扩展到非单调函数和细粒度参数，即多维阈值。为了将量化函数组合自动转换为阈值表示，我们提出了一种系统化方法，通过集成到基于ONNX的编译器基础设施中的代数规则来实现。我们通过实验在一系列单调激活函数上验证了我们的解决方案。
tldr: 本文将多阈值表示形式化并扩展至非单调激活函数与多维细粒度阈值参数，提出基于代数规则并集成到ONNX编译器基础设施中的系统化自动转换方法，从而在定制DNN加速器上实现更广泛的量化激活函数高效硬件加速。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes and extends the multi-threshold representation to non-monotonic activations and multi-dimensional fine-granular thresholds, proposing a systematic algebraic-rule-based automated conversion integrated into ONNX compiler infrastructure for efficient hardware acceleration of a broader range of quantized activations in custom-tailored DNN accelerators.
